title: Salesforce and Microsoft Announce Copilotforce, Bringing Salesforce Customer Context and Sales Workflows to Microsoft Copilot
summary: New integrations bring Salesforce customer context and sales workflows into Microsoft Copilot, enable real-time CRM collaboration in Microsoft Teams, and
body_markdown:
*New integrations bring Salesforce customer context and sales workflows into Microsoft Copilot, enable real-time CRM collaboration in Microsoft Teams, and connect Salesforce Data 360 with Microsoft Fabric through bidirectional zero-copy data access. Accenture is serving as design and implementation partner along with being customer zero, deploying the integrations in its own global sales organization.*


---


**SAN FRANCISCO & REDMOND, Wash. – November 17, 2026** . Today at Microsoft Ignite, Salesforce and Microsoft announced Copilotforce, a partnership bringing Salesforce to Microsoft’s expansive enterprise productivity ecosystem, alongside new integrations across Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Fabric. The collaboration extends Salesforce customer context, AI capabilities, and sales workflows into one of the largest enterprise software environments, bringing Salesforce closer to where employees already work.


With Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot, sellers will be able to access Salesforce customer context, analyze opportunities, prepare for meetings, prioritize opportunities, and take CRM actions informed by Teams conversations, Outlook emails, and shared documents. Separately, bidirectional[zero-copy capabilities](https://www.salesforce.com/data/zero-copy-partner-network/) connect Salesforce[Data 360](https://www.salesforce.com/data/?d=cta-body-promo-8) and Microsoft Fabric without duplicating datasets, allowing organizations to query Fabric data natively within Data 360 and securely share Data 360 intelligence into Fabric.


These capabilities build on[Sales Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/?d=cta-body-promo-8) in Teams, which brings Salesforce CRM insights and workflows into Microsoft Teams, introduced at Dreamforce and currently in pilot. Together, the integrations will allow sellers to prep for meetings in Copilot or Teams, or update supported opportunity details in Teams.


*“Through Copilotforce, we’re bringing Salesforce to the largest surface in enterprise software today, embedding trusted Salesforce context and intelligent sales workflows directly where sellers work. By bringing together the #1 CRM with the #1 productivity surface, we’re transforming AI from a standalone tool into a powerful driver of productivity, smarter decisions, and customer success.”* *–* ***Miguel Milano, President, Chief Operating Officer, Salesforce***


*“AI is only as powerful as the data and context that grounds it. Bringing Salesforce customer data and sales skills together with the work context delivered by Work IQ in Microsoft Copilot allows our joint customers to unlock actionable insights across their core business applications. Copilotforce will give sales teams the intelligence they need to make faster, higher-confidence decisions while maintaining the governance and trust enterprises demand.”* *– **Judson Althoff, CEO, Microsoft Commercial Business***


## **AI context where employees already work**


Powered by[AIforce](https://www.salesforce.com/artificial-intelligence/) , the live interface layer that brings Salesforce capabilities into external AI environments, Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot will bring Sales Cloud workflows into the tools sellers already use. Sellers will be able to prepare for meetings, review opportunities, and take supported sales actions using Salesforce customer context.


- **Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot:** Will enable sales and revenue teams to ask natural-language questions and receive grounded, actionable outputs; will also enable users to take Salesforce actions directly within Copilot. Work IQ, the intelligence layer that powers Copilot, synthesizes Salesforce insights with relevant relationships and content from Teams meetings, Outlook emails, and shared documents across SharePoint and OneDrive. Key daily sales workflows will include:


- **Customer Meeting Preparation:** Combine account history and meeting transcripts into a single executive brief, saving hours of prep time and eliminating app-switching.
- **Deal-Health Analysis:** Surface hidden deal risks and customer sentiment, enabling sellers to focus on the right actions before deals stall.
- **Pipeline Review & Action Plans:** Turn complex pipeline data into ready-to-execute close plans directly inside Word and PowerPoint, slashing administrative overhead.


- **Salesforce in Teams:** Building on the pilot demonstrated at Dreamforce 2026, the Sales Cloud in Teams app will bring rich business context and real-time insights directly where over 400M active users already chat and collaborate. Sellers will be able to act on those insights with Agentforce Coworker, with updates automatically syncing back to Salesforce, and it brings the same Salesforce permissions and governance coordinating the right Agentforce agents, and turns the chat into action. Sellers will gain a real-time view of pipeline and quota progress, receive active deal notifications, and access AI-driven briefing materials. Interactive adaptive cards will enable sellers to update supported opportunity details, with changes saved back to Salesforce, and share secure records in deal rooms to align cross-functional teams without tool-switching.


## **Enterprise-grade governance and source-level permissions**


Enterprise AI requires strict[data protection](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/platform/data-backup-recovery/what-is-data-protection/) and[governance](https://www.salesforce.com/data/governance/guide/) controls. Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot operates through authenticated user access, preserving the granular permissions, sharing rules, and audit trails established in both environments.


Customer data remains protected at every boundary: Salesforce controls data access and governs supported business actions, while Microsoft ensures communications and documents adhere to existing enterprise compliance policies. Supported writeback actions to the CRM require explicit user confirmation and respect existing validation rules, helping ensure customer records remain governed and auditable.


## **Access enterprise context without migration or duplication**


[AI models](https://www.salesforce.com/artificial-intelligence/ai-models/) and enterprise workflows are only as effective as the data and context they can reach. Salesforce and Microsoft are delivering bidirectional Zero Copy integration between Salesforce Data 360 and Microsoft Fabric, allowing organizations to harmonize and activate data across platforms and turn customer, operational, and financial data into trusted context for AI, without maintaining duplicate datasets or running brittle[ETL pipelines](https://www.salesforce.com/data/connectivity/etl/) .


- **Data Federation:** Joint customers can now query and analyze supported Microsoft Fabric OneLake data directly within Salesforce Data 360, leaving the source data in Fabric. This native Zero Copy connection brings Salesforce and Microsoft Fabric data together, turning it into enterprise-wide context across Salesforce experiences: Sales and service teams get a richer view of each customer, marketers build segments from the combined data, analysts explore it in[Tableau](https://www.tableau.com/?d=cta-body-promo-8) , and[Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/?d=cta-body-promo-8) uses it to answer questions and complete tasks.
- **Salesforce Data 360 Data Sharing:** Organizations will be able to securely share curated Salesforce Data 360 customer context and intelligence into Microsoft OneLake. Enterprise data science and business intelligence teams will be able to analyze customer trends alongside enterprise datasets, helping business leaders make decisions with a more complete picture of their customers and operations. That combined context will support custom analytics, reporting, and enterprise AI workloads without maintaining duplicate datasets, helping teams make more informed decisions grounded in trusted customer context.


## **Trusted enterprise data for Microsoft AI and analytics ecosystem**


[Enterprise AI](https://www.salesforce.com/artificial-intelligence/enterprise-ai/) and analytics systems demand trusted data, rich business contexts, and governed access. Through an expanded collaboration with Microsoft, Informatica helps customers make confident decisions, simplify AI development, and understand the data powering their AI and Analytics workloads. The new[Informatica Plugin for Copilot](https://www.salesforce.com/news/stories/informatica-trusted-enterprise-data-microsoft-collaboration/) empowers business users to discover relevant data, address data quality issues, and verify the authoritativeness and reliability of the underlying data using natural-language queries. Enhanced Foundry capabilities enable developers to build high quality and governed AI agents with minimal custom integration. Additionally, expanded Fabric scanning helps data and AI teams trace data lineage and analyze downstream impacts on analytics.


## **Accenture: validating real-world value**


Accenture is collaborating with Salesforce and Microsoft as the design and implementation partner to shape the enterprise solution architecture and bring deep expertise in delivering business outcomes across 13 industries globally.


Having scaled Microsoft Copilot to more than 740,000 people and as one of the largest Salesforce users globally with 55,000 active users, Accenture is serving as Customer Zero for this solution, deploying and validating the integrations within its own global sales organization and sharing learnings to help customers reach value sooner. Through real-world deployment, the companies are helping clients turn investments they have already made in Salesforce and Microsoft into a better way to sell, driving faster growth and getting deals back on track.


*“As a Global Partner of the Year for both Salesforce and Microsoft and one of their top customers, we are uniquely positioned to bring our expertise to help design and implement Copilotforce so that our clients can quickly get more value from their technology investments. The combined strengths of our three companies will reinvent sales with AI, giving sellers more time with customers while trusted intelligence and agents work alongside them in the tools they already use. We are also excited to serve as customer zero for Copilotforce.” **– Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO, Accenture***


##### **Availability Roadmap:**


- **Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot – Public Preview (Beta)** Integration enabling sales teams to ask natural-language questions and receive grounded, actionable outputs. Available in our AgentExchange and the Microsoft Copilot plugin directory.
- **Salesforce in Teams **–** Pilot** **** The Sales Cloud in Teams app brings rich business context and real-time insights to enable sellers to view pipeline progress. While Agentforce Coworker allows sellers to delegate work and take action directly within Teams without leaving the teams.
- **Data Federation – Generally Available** Allows joint customers to natively query and analyze Microsoft Fabric OneLake data directly within Salesforce Data 360 without leaving the source data in Fabric or maintaining duplicate datasets. Available on our[Data 360 Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/data/data-cloud-int/guide/c360-a-microsoftfabriconelake-connector.html) .
- **Salesforce Data 360 Data Sharing – Public Preview, Beta** Allows organizations to securely share curated Salesforce Data 360 context and intelligence into Microsoft OneLake to support custom analytics, reporting, and enterprise AI workloads. Available on our[Data 360 Help Page](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=data.c360_a_share_data_with_onelake.htm&type=5) .


### More information:


- [Learn more about the Salesforce in Copilot Plugin](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.what_is_microsoft_copilot.htm&type=5)
- [Learn more about Informatica](https://www.salesforce.com/news/stories/informatica-trusted-enterprise-data-microsoft-collaboration/)


*Pricing and packaging are subject to change. Regional availability and customer access are governed by applicable customer agreements. Customers should base purchasing decisions on capabilities that are commercially available today.*
